description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects a hop-by-hop Connection token naming X-Real-Ip on the actuator route.
affected_versions: Versa Concerto: 12.1.2 through 12.2.0; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects a hop-by-hop Connection token naming X-Real-Ip on the actuator route.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate clients using that unusual hop-header declaration are denied.
